\"條理分明、行動有序，能把混亂化為可執行的秩序，成為團隊可依靠的結構者。\": "Clear and orderly in thought and action. You turn chaos into workable order and become the structure a team can lean on."
\"控制慾變強、過度理性、失去彈性——系統開始僵化，創造力跟著受限。\": "The urge to control grows, you get overly rational and lose flexibility. The system stiffens, and creativity shrinks with it."
\"從「控制」轉為「承載」：讓結構服務目標，而不是讓人服務結構。\": "Move from controlling to holding: let structure serve the goal, instead of making people serve the structure."
\"能擁抱情緒、聆聽他人，把感受轉化為理解——你是情緒場裡讓人安心的存在。\": "You can hold emotions, listen to others, and turn feelings into understanding. In an emotional room, you are the presence that makes people feel safe."
\"被他人情緒淹沒、過度共感、自我模糊，長期下來精神疲倦、容易崩潰。\": "You get flooded by other people's emotions, over-empathize and lose track of yourself. Over time you become worn out and fragile."
\"從「吸收」轉為「流動」：感受可以經過你，不必留在你身上。\": "Move from absorbing to letting it flow: feelings can pass through you without staying in you."
\"敢直面困難，能在低谷中提煉出智慧，成為別人改變的觸媒。\": "You face difficulty head-on, draw wisdom out of low points, and become the spark for other people's change."
\"沉溺在痛苦裡、反覆內耗、掉進「都是我不好／都是別人害的」的劇本。\": "You sink into pain, wear yourself out going in circles, and fall into the script of \"it's all my fault\" or \"it's all their fault\"."
\"把「挫折是懲罰」改寫成「挫折是材料」——你最擅長的本來就是重寫劇本。\": "Rewrite \"setbacks are punishment\" as \"setbacks are material\". Rewriting the script is what you do best."
\"靈感清晰、判斷敏銳，能比別人早一步看見重點，並把模糊的訊息翻譯成大家聽得懂的: "Clear inspiration, sharp judgment. You see the point early and translate vague signals into language everyone can follow."
\"訊息過載、難以分辨哪些是直覺哪些是焦慮，容易疲倦渙散、心神不定。\": "Overloaded with input, you struggle to tell intuition from anxiety, and you get tired, scattered and unsettled."
\"從「被動接收」轉為「主動篩選」：你可以決定頻道什麼時候開、什麼時候關。\": "Move from passively receiving to actively filtering: you get to decide when the channel is open and when it's closed."
\"積極行動、勇於表達，能在混亂中帶出方向與節奏，是團隊的推進器。\": "Active and outspoken, you bring direction and pace out of chaos. You are the team's engine."
\"衝動行事、帶著情緒推進、聽不進別人——消耗自己，也製造誤會。\": "You act on impulse, push forward on emotion and stop listening, which drains you and creates misunderstandings."
\"從「反應」轉為「回應」：先確認方向，再全速前進。\": "Move from reacting to responding: check the direction first, then go full speed."
\"平靜、有包容力，能穩住波動的場面——你是團隊的定錨。\": "Calm and accepting, you steady rough moments. You are the team's anchor."
\"壓抑感覺、迴避衝突、假性平靜——把自己關起來，身體僵硬、關係疏離。\": "You suppress feelings, avoid conflict and fake calm. You shut yourself in, your body tenses, and relationships drift."
\"分清「麻木」與「安定」：穩定不是沒有感覺，是有感覺仍然站得住。\": "Tell numbness apart from steadiness: being steady doesn't mean feeling nothing; it means feeling and still standing."
\"促進合作、善於傾聽，能整合多方觀點，讓團隊的協作順暢、成果加倍。\": "You foster collaboration, listen well and bring different views together, so teamwork runs smoothly and results multiply."
\"過度討好、害怕衝突、迷失在別人的需求裡——精神耗竭、越來越不知道自己要什麼。: "You people-please, fear conflict and get lost in other people's needs, until you're exhausted and less and less sure what you want."
\"從「取悅每個人」轉為「對齊共同目標」：合作不是犧牲，是一起變強。\": "Move from pleasing everyone to aligning on a shared goal: collaboration isn't sacrifice; it's getting stronger together."
\"觀察入微、表達清晰，能用文字與語言建立秩序，把散落的經驗變成可傳承的知識。\: "You observe closely and express things clearly, creating order with words and turning scattered experience into knowledge that can be passed on."
\"過度分析、停在思考層、害怕行動——知識一直堆疊，卻遲遲派不上用場。\": "You over-analyze, stay in your head and hesitate to act. Knowledge piles up but never gets used."
\"從「分析」轉為「見證」：先記錄真實，再追求完美。\": "Move from analyzing to witnessing: record what's true first, and perfect it later."
\"能深度共感又不迷失，在愛裡保持界線——你身邊的人會因為你而變得柔軟。\": "You feel deeply without losing yourself and keep boundaries in love. The people around you soften because of you."
\"過度付出、依附或被依附、情緒界線模糊——容易焦慮、倦怠、失去自我。\": "You over-give, cling or get clung to, and your emotional boundaries blur. You get anxious, burned out and lose yourself."
\"從「情緒同步」轉為「理解對方、保有自己」：愛不是拯救，是一起看見真實。\": "Move from syncing emotions to understanding the other while keeping yourself: love isn't rescuing; it's seeing what's real together."
\"精準、專注、有整合創新的能力，能讓不同的系統與工具協同運作。\": "Precise, focused and inventive at integration, you get different systems and tools working in concert."
\"過度理性、與感受斷線——做出來的東西精準卻冰冷，沒有人想用。\": "Overly rational and cut off from feeling, you build things that are precise but cold, and no one wants to use them."
\"從「控制」轉為「協作」：工具是為人服務的，效率也可以有溫度。\": "Move from controlling to collaborating: tools serve people, and efficiency can be warm."
\"願景清晰、能鼓舞他人，把想法變成大家願意跟隨的方向。\": "Your vision is clear and you inspire others, turning ideas into a direction people want to follow."
\"控制慾強、孤傲、過度承擔——壓力堆在自己身上，越領導越孤單。\": "You become controlling and aloof and take on too much. The pressure piles up on you, and the more you lead, the lonelier it gets."
\"從「帶領」轉為「啟動」：最好的領導，是讓每個人記得自己的方向。\": "Move from leading to igniting: the best leadership helps everyone remember their own direction."
\"律動自然、表達流暢，能用節奏與行動把現場帶活——你在，場子就是活的。\": "Natural rhythm and fluent expression. You bring a room to life through rhythm and action; when you're there, the room is alive."
\"身體僵硬、表達受限、情緒卡在身體裡——容易焦慮、倦怠。\": "Your body stiffens, expression gets blocked and emotions get stuck in your body. You become anxious and worn out."
\"從「控制身體」轉為「傾聽身體」：節奏回來了，狀態就回來了。\": "Move from controlling your body to listening to it: when the rhythm comes back, so do you."
